title: Durable LiminalDB proof state becomes a bounded RINSE reflection without creating semantic authority

scope.scale: cross-repository native segment / durable evidence to interpretation boundary

ideaContract.purpose: Independently verify that the exact SYSTEM-005 durable ProofPath record can be consumed by canonical RINSE as an immutable source trace and reinterpreted only through the existing reflection graph, without rewriting source history, creating a second interpretation authority or granting execution authority.
ideaContract.expectedOutcome: A fresh canonical SYSTEM-005 durable record is replayed from LiminalDB, validated by the exact canonical RINSE durable-source adapter, projected into a source trace whose identity preserves the durable record hash, interpreted deterministically by the existing reflection_graph v0.2 core, bounded as REFLECTION_ONLY / ACCEPT_WITH_LIMITS, and accepted by native LTP strict replay.
invariants: the SYSTEM-005 logical_operation_id survives durable replay and RINSE projection unchanged
the durable record hash remains the RINSE source-trace identity rather than being replaced by a new source authority
exact durable event and admission bytes remain unchanged during RINSE derivation
the RINSE adapter validates semantic authority fields in addition to byte digests
reflection identity and digest are created only by the existing canonical RINSE reflection core
the durable source trace is referenced by the reflection but never mutated or overwritten
recorded durable state does not become underlying real-world truth authority
all reflection and candidate handoff authority remains REFLECTION_ONLY and non-executable
valid time, durable recorded time and review time remain separate coordinates
the agent trajectory through durable replay and reinterpretation is independently inspectable and replayable
forbiddenOutcomes: creating a ProofPath-specific RINSE interpretation engine or second reflection identity scheme
treating the durable record as proof that the underlying real-world claim is true
rewriting the durable source event or admission report during interpretation
changing source-trace identity from the durable record hash to an interpretation-generated identity
allowing persisted storage authority to become reflection execution authority
accepting a semantic durable_memory escalation merely because its source digest was recomputed
emitting an executable RINSE candidate handoff
claiming a correct final reflection when the LTP trajectory is inadmissible
ideaContract.parentContract: NEO REZONANS heartbeat / LiminalDB durable evidence -> RINSE immutable source trace -> REFLECTION_ONLY interpretation

evidence.claim: SYSTEM-005 supplies a canonical local/test durable ProofPath record that survives restart, preserves first durable transaction time and reconciles retry ambiguity without duplicate effects.
The canonical RINSE read-only adapter validates the SYSTEM-005 source boundary and delegates interpretation identity and authority to the existing reflection graph core.

evidence.ref: FCRP-SYSTEM-006 workflow / byte digests before and after RINSE derivation
evidence.claim: The durable event and admission bytes are unchanged, and the normalized RINSE trace identity contains the exact durable record hash.
The existing canonical RINSE core deterministically produces ACCEPT_WITH_LIMITS, REFLECTION_ONLY authority and non-executable candidate handoff from the durable source trace.

evidence.ref: FCRP-SYSTEM-006 workflow / durable_memory semantic escalation with recomputed source digest
evidence.claim: RINSE rejects semantic authority escalation even when source bytes and durable digest are internally consistent.
The durable-replay to bounded-reflection trajectory is accepted by the pinned native LTP strict inspector and deterministic replay.

past.summary: SYSTEM-005 crossed the local/test persistence frontier and produced restart-replayable durable ProofPath evidence, but the downstream RINSE stage was not yet independently exercised against that exact durable source.

present.summary: RINSE now exposes a canonical read-only durable ProofPath source adapter that projects the exact durable record into the existing reflection graph while preserving source identity and REFLECTION_ONLY authority. SYSTEM-006 independently re-exercises that exact capability.

future.summary: A later gate may carry the bounded RINSE reinterpretation back into RESONANCE or another consumer, but no current result authorizes production persistence, executable handoff, source rewrite or truth promotion.

causalPath.statement: Durable evidence availability is not semantic truth or interpretation authority; the downstream consumer must preserve the source record while deriving only a bounded non-executable interpretation.

The NEO REZONANS architecture names LiminalDB -> RINSE, but before SYSTEM-006 the durable SYSTEM-005 record had not been independently consumed through a native RINSE source adapter and canonical reflection core.
Consume the exact durable record through the canonical RINSE read-only adapter, retain the durable record hash as source-trace identity, and invoke only the existing reflection_graph v0.2 core.
Exact durable event/admission bytes remain unchanged and the normalized source trace points back to the durable record hash rather than replacing it.
The canonical RINSE core deterministically derives a SUPPORTED_WITH_LIMITS reflection, ACCEPT_WITH_LIMITS graph verdict, REFLECTION_ONLY authority and non-executable candidate handoff.
The independent trajectory from durable replay through immutable source projection and bounded RINSE reinterpretation is accepted by native LTP strict inspection and replay.

navigation.reason: The missing guarantee is a sibling repository transfer from durable evidence storage into interpretation semantics, with source immutability and authority separation preserved across the boundary.

refactor.change: Use the exact canonical RINSE durable-source adapter as a read-only projection and the existing reflection graph as the sole interpretation authority for the SYSTEM-005 durable record.
refactor.expectedEffect: The LiminalDB -> RINSE heartbeat becomes native and independently replayable while durable source identity stays immutable and reinterpretation remains REFLECTION_ONLY.

authorization.authorityBoundary: SYSTEM-006 performs only ephemeral local/test durable replay and read-only RINSE interpretation. It grants no source mutation, production persistence, truth authorization, executable handoff, deployment, financial action or external effect.
